property_summary: The return value of owner() matches the immutable owner stored at offset 0x0 of calldata, not the debt token address.
The address returned by owner() is not equal to the debt token address.
The owner address is never equal to the debt token address.
The return value of owner() always remains unchanged after calling approveTransfer.
The address returned by owner() is equal to the owner address stored at the beginning of the immutable calldata, not the debt token address.
The collateral() function returns the same address as the immutable argument for address offset 0x14.
After calling approveTransfer with the owner of a loan's collateral, the approval mapping for that loan records the owner's address.
For any existing loan, after approveTransfer is called by the lender, the approval mapping for that loan records the address specified in the transfer.
Given any two addresses, after calling approveTransfer on a loan with the lender set to the first address, the approval mapping for that loan equals the second address.
The collateral address returned by C.collateral() is always equal to the address passed in the constructor's immutable data.
The debt() function always returns the same non-zero address for any fuzz inputs.
The debt() return value is non-zero for any valid token configuration.
The debt() function returns a non-zero address for any fuzz inputs that result in the Cooler being used.
The debt token address is independent of the caller and equal to the address stored in immutable args at offset 0x28.
The debt() function never returns the zero address regardless of the fuzz parameters.
For any owner and lender, the factory address returned by the contract is constant and equal to the address deployed in the reference.
The factory address returned by c.factory() is the address of the CoolerFactory contract deployed in the reference.
Calling approveTransfer with any lender and loanID always succeeds when msg.sender is the lender and the returned factory address equals the one stored in the immutable variable.
The factory address returned by c.factory() is the same as the address stored in the CoolerFactory contract deployed during setUp, for any call to approveTransfer.
The factory address returned by c.factory() is always equal to the address of the CoolerFactory contract that created c.
P.approvals(k) can only be set by the owner after an approveTransfer call.
The approvals mapping can only be modified by the lender of the corresponding loan.
After approveTransfer is called, the approvals mapping for the given loanID is set to the provided address if and only if the caller is the lender of that loan.
After any call to approveTransfer, the approvals mapping for the given loanID is set to the provided address if and only if the caller is the lender of that loan.
approveTransfer only changes the approvals for a loan ID when the caller is the lender of that loan.
Only the lender of a loan can call approveTransfer for that loan
After calling approveTransfer(to, loanID), the approval for that loanID is set to to (i.e., c.approvals(loanID) == to) regardless of who called it.
After calling approveTransfer(to, loanID) as the lender, the approval for that loanID is set to to; a non-lender caller must not change the approval, and the reference reverts.
After approveTransfer is called, the approvals mapping for the given loanID remains set to the approved address.
After approveTransfer is called, the approvals mapping for the given loanID remains set to the approved address (the caller).
After approveTransfer sets an approval for loanID, the owner of the loan remains the original lender until transferOwnership is called by the approved address.
After approveTransfer sets a non-zero approval for a loan, the approval mapping for that loan ID is non-zero.
After approveTransfer sets an approval for a loanID, the lender of that loan remains unchanged.
After a transfer of ownership via transferOwnership for a loan, the approvals mapping for that loan is always reset to address(0).
After approveTransfer and then transferOwnership, the approvals mapping for the transferred loan is reset to address(0).
After a successful transferOwnership, the approvals mapping for the transferred loan must be reset to address(0).
After approveTransfer and then transferOwnership, the approvals mapping for the transferred loan is always reset to address(0).
After transferOwnership succeeds, the approvals mapping for that loan is cleared to address(0).
